description: macOS APFS laptop of suspect tuckgorge (Digital Corpora 2019, examiner Simson Garfinkel). Five signal clusters converge on eco-terrorism planning trajectory: (1) sustained ELF/ALF radicalization research campaign Jul-Aug 2019 (NYT ELF arson clip, 133MB Intercept FBI eco-terror article, climate/earthquake PDFs, Earth Day webarchive); (2) curated arson imagery folder 'Good Start Photos' containing Quinn's Crossing ELF arson photograph and fire-themed 'Setting Fires' music video screenshots; (3) sequential material acquisition research Oct 18-20 2019 (nitrogen fertilizer Urea 46-0-0, 45-gallon barrels, Home Depot 55-gallon blue industrial drum); (4) covert communications research (VPN over HTTP: SoftEther, chisel, crowbar) corroborated by Gmail thread on same topic; (5) counter-forensics awareness (Autopsy DFIR tool searches, silent camera research, Apple privacy research, encrypted backup decision). peirce_chain.secondness: 133MB deliberate PDF save is not incidental browsing. 'Good Start Photos' folder name is an editorial judgment on arson imagery. Nitrogen fertilizer + barrel search within 38 seconds is not gardening planning. SoftEther/chisel/crowbar are for bypassing network monitoring — not standard privacy VPNs. Gmail VPN thread confirms group coordination on same evasion. 'Autopsey' misspelling indicates first-time DFIR research. Sequential Cluster B (Oct 16-20) is operationally coherent.
peirce_chain.thirdness: Radicalized actor in early operational phase of eco-terrorism planning. ELF ideological research + aspirational arson imagery + material procurement + covert communications setup + counter-forensics research = pre-operational pattern matching ELF cell-based structure documented in actor's own saved research materials. Carnegie: inspiration from documented attack (Good Start Photos), evasion from network monitoring (VPN over HTTP).

devil_advocate: All findings individually explainable: academic/journalistic ELF research; music fan fire imagery; gardening nitrogen fertilizer; rain barrel composting; privacy VPN research; medical/TV autopsy interest. Convergence requires evaluation as a whole. No purchase confirmation for materials. No file deletions or log wiping present.
